auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT s.XCL_095
FROM sets s
JOIN cards c ON c.XCL_018 = s.XCL_099
WHERE s.XCL_105 = 'Commander'
  AND c.XCL_019 NOT IN ('Alchemy', 'Alchemy Modified')
GROUP BY s.XCL_095
ORDER BY COUNT(c.XCL_001) DESC
LIMIT 1
